pipelines.name: Actionlint

steps.name: Download Actionlint
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl -OLXGET https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v"${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}"/actionlint_"${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}"_linux_amd64.tar.gz
echo "${CHECKSUM}  actionlint_${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
tar xzf actionlint_"${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}"_linux_amd64.tar.gz
test -f actionlint
chmod +x actionlint

steps.name: Run Actionlint
steps.run:
echo "::add-matcher::.github/actionlint-matcher.json"
./actionlint -color

pipelines.name: changelog

steps.name: Ensure no changes to the CHANGELOG
steps.run:
BASE=$(git merge-base origin/main ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }})
if [[ $(git diff --name-only "$BASE" ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} ./CHANGELOG.md) ]]
then
  echo "The CHANGELOG should not be directly modified."
  echo "Please add a .yaml file to the ./.chloggen/ directory."
  echo "See CONTRIBUTING.md for more details."
  echo "Alternately, add either \"[chore]\" to the title of the pull request or add the \"Skip Changelog\" label if this job should be skipped."
  false
else
  echo "The CHANGELOG was not modified."
fi

steps.name: Ensure ./.chloggen/*.yaml addition(s)
steps.run:
BASE=$(git merge-base origin/main ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }})
if [[ 1 -gt $(git diff --diff-filter=A --name-only "$BASE" ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} ./.chloggen | grep -c \\.yaml) ]]
then
  echo "No changelog entry was added to the ./.chloggen/ directory."
  echo "Please add a .yaml file to the ./.chloggen/ directory."
  echo "See CONTRIBUTING.md for more details."
  echo "Alternately, add either \"[chore]\" to the title of the pull request or add the \"Skip Changelog\" label if this job should be skipped."
  false
else
  echo "A changelog entry was added to the ./.chloggen/ directory."
fi

steps.name: Validate ./.chloggen/*.yaml changes
steps.run:
make chlog-validate \
  || { echo "New ./.chloggen/*.yaml file failed validation."; exit 1; }

steps.name: Render .chloggen changelog entries
steps.run: make chlog-preview > changelog_preview.md 2>&1

steps.name: Install markdown-link-check
steps.run: npm install -g markdown-link-check@3.12.2

steps.name: Run markdown-link-check
steps.run:
markdown-link-check \
  --verbose \
  --config .github/workflows/check_links_config.json \
  changelog_preview.md \
  || { echo "Check that anchor links are lowercase"; exit 1; }

steps.name: Collect diagnostics on failure

echo "=== Operator logs ==="

steps.name: Start kind
steps.run: kind create cluster --config kind-${{ matrix.kube-version }}.yaml --wait 5m

steps.name: Start a local container registry with TLS
steps.run:
# install mkcert with pinned version and checksum for reproducible builds
MKCERT_VERSION=v1.4.4
MKCERT_SHA256=6d31c65b03972c6dc4a14ab429f2928300518b26503f58723e532d1b0a3bbb52
curl -sLo mkcert "https://github.com/FiloSottile/mkcert/releases/download/${MKCERT_VERSION}/mkcert-${MKCERT_VERSION}-linux-amd64"
echo "${MKCERT_SHA256}  mkcert" | sha256sum -c
chmod +x mkcert
sudo cp mkcert /usr/local/bin/mkcert

# create and install root CA in system store
sudo mkcert -install
sudo systemctl restart docker

# copy root CA in kind's system store
sudo docker cp "$(sudo mkcert -CAROOT)/rootCA.pem" kind-control-plane:/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/mkcert.crt
docker exec kind-control-plane update-ca-certificates
docker exec kind-control-plane systemctl restart containerd

# generate cert for registry
mkdir -p /tmp/localregistry/certs
sudo mkcert -cert-file /tmp/localregistry/certs/tls.crt -key-file /tmp/localregistry/certs/tls.key localregistry

# make registry reachable
host_ip=$(dig +short "$(hostname)" | head -n1)
echo "$host_ip localregistry" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts

# start registry
docker run -d \
  --restart=always \
  --name registry \
  -v /tmp/localregistry/certs:/certs \
  -e REGISTRY_HTTP_TLS_CERTIFICATE=/certs/tls.crt \
  -e REGISTRY_HTTP_TLS_KEY=/certs/tls.key \
  -p 5000:5000 \
  registry:2

steps.name: Install chainsaw, OLM and minio
steps.run:
set -e
make chainsaw olm-install

steps.name: Build and push operator and bundle image to local container registry
steps.run:
kubectl wait --for=create packagemanifest/tempo-operator -n olm --timeout=5m
LATEST_VERSION=$(kubectl get packagemanifest tempo-operator -n olm -o jsonpath='{.status.channels[?(@.name=="alpha")].currentCSVDesc.version}')

if [ -z "$LATEST_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::Could not resolve the Tempo Operator version from OLM"
  exit 1
fi

make opm
export BUNDLE_IMGS=ghcr.io/grafana/tempo-operator/tempo-operator-bundle:v${LATEST_VERSION},${IMG_PREFIX}/tempo-operator-bundle:v${OPERATOR_VERSION}
make bundle docker-build docker-push bundle-build bundle-push catalog-build catalog-push
echo "run-upgrade=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

pipelines.name: Prepare the release

steps.name: Sync fork
steps.run:
# synchronizing the fork is fast, and avoids the need to fetch the full upstream repo
# (fetching the upstream repo with "--depth 1" would lead to "shallow update not allowed"
#  error when pushing back to the origin repo)
gh repo sync "$OPERATOR_BOT_USER/${REPOSITORY_NAME}" \
    --source ${{ github.repository }} \
    --force

steps.name: Update makefile
steps.run: sed -i.bak "s/OPERATOR_VERSION ?= .*/OPERATOR_VERSION ?= $OPERATOR_VERSION/g" Makefile && rm Makefile.bak

steps.name: Generate bundle
steps.run: make bundle

steps.name: Generate CHANGELOG
steps.run: make chlog-update

steps.name: Commit the changes to the repository and create PR
steps.run:
git config user.name "$OPERATOR_BOT_USER"
git config user.email "41898282+$OPERATOR_BOT_USER@users.noreply.github.com"
git checkout -b "releases/${VERSION}"
git add -A
git commit -m "Prepare Release ${VERSION}" --author="${ACTOR} <${ACTOR}@users.noreply.github.com>"
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${OPERATOR_BOT_USER}/${REPOSITORY_NAME}"
git push -f --set-upstream origin "releases/${VERSION}"
gh pr create --title="Prepare release v${VERSION}" --body="v${VERSION}" --repo ${{ github.repository }}

pipelines.name: Reusable - Create operator hub pull request

steps.name: Sync fork
steps.run:
# synchronizing the fork is fast, and avoids the need to fetch the full upstream repo
# (fetching the upstream repo with "--depth 1" would lead to "shallow update not allowed"
#  error when pushing back to the origin repo)
gh repo sync "tempooperatorbot/${REPO}" \
    --source "${ORG}/${REPO}" \
    --force

steps.name: Determine operator version to release
steps.run: echo "version=$(grep -Eo '## [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' tmp/CHANGELOG.md | head -n 1 | awk '{print $2}')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Update version
steps.run:
mkdir "operators/tempo-operator/${VERSION}"
cp -R "./tmp/bundle/${BUNDLE_TYPE}/"* "operators/tempo-operator/${VERSION}"
rm -rf ./tmp

steps.name: Use CLA approved github bot
steps.run:
git config user.name tempobot
git config user.email 150731540+grafana@users.noreply.github.com

steps.name: Create pull request against ${{ inputs.org }}/${{ inputs.repo }}
steps.run:
message="Update the tempo to $VERSION"
body="Release tempo-operator \`$VERSION\`.

cc @pavolloffay @frzifus @andreasgerstmayr @rubenvp8510 @iblancasa
"
branch="update-tempo-operator-to-${VERSION}"

# gh pr create doesn't have a way to explicitly specify different head and base
# repositories currently, but it will implicitly pick up the head from a different
# repository if you set up a tracking branch

git checkout -b "$branch"
git add -A
git commit -s -m "$message"
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/tempooperatorbot/${REPO}"
git push -f --set-upstream origin "$branch"
gh pr create --title "$message" --body "$body" --repo "${ORG}/${REPO}" --base main
